hints: What base or side length is given?
Write that same value multiplied by itself.
Use the matching multiplication fact and label an area with square units when appropriate.
Which whole number might be multiplied by itself here?
Compare with nearby square facts from the multiplication table.
Verify by multiplying the candidate number by itself.

objective: Value of a digit by position
hints: Locate the requested digit or place column in the numeral.
Name the place unit represented by that column.
If the question asks for its value, multiply the digit by the value of its place; if it asks for the digit, give the digit itself.

constraints: numbers up to 5 digits, may include internal zeros
hints: Identify every place column from left to right, including a column with zero.
Multiply each nonzero digit by the value of its place.
For expanded form, write those contributions joined by plus signs; if one digit is requested, give only its contribution.

constraints: numbers up to 5 digits, same or different digit counts
hints: First compare digit counts, or align the numbers by place columns.
At the highest unequal column, determine which digit has the greater value.
Return the larger or smaller number or comparison symbol exactly as the question asks.
Find the least or greatest remaining number by digit count and then place value.
Place that number first, then repeat with the numbers left.
Check each adjacent pair follows the requested increasing or decreasing direction.

objective: Round to the nearest ten or hundred
hints: Which place are you rounding to, and which digit immediately to its right decides?
Keep the target digit or increase it by one according to whether the deciding digit is below five or at least five.
Replace all smaller places with zeros and check the rounded value is nearest at the requested place.

objective: Round to larger places, including boundary cases
constraints: up to 4 digits; include boundary (5) cases
hints: Which place are you rounding to, and which digit immediately to its right decides?
Keep the target digit or increase it by one according to whether the deciding digit is below five or at least five.
Replace all smaller places with zeros and check the rounded value is nearest at the requested place.
Align the addends by ones, tens, and hundreds before adding.
At each column, record the ones digit and regroup ten ones into the next place when needed.
Add the columns again, including every regrouped ten or hundred, to check the total.
Add the ones column first and record any regrouped amount for the next column.
Include the incoming regrouped amount when adding each new column.
Check whether regrouping continues into the hundreds column and include it there.

constraints: three addends, up to 3 digits each
hints: Add all three digits in one column together with any incoming carry.
Separate the full tens from the remaining ones, carrying the entire full-tens count.
Repeat in each place and check every addend was included once.
Align the numbers by place value and identify the first column where the top digit is too small.
Regroup one unit from the place to the left, then subtract each column using the changed digits.
Add the difference and the subtrahend to check that they recover the minuend.

constraints: 3-digit numbers, at least one borrow, no zeros in the minuend
hints: Align the numbers by place value and identify the first column where the top digit is too small.
Regroup one unit from the place to the left, then subtract each column using the changed digits.
Add the difference and the subtrahend to check that they recover the minuend.

constraints: 2-3 digit numbers; encourage the addition check
hints: If a needed column has too little, look left until you find a nonzero place to exchange.
Pass the exchange through any zero columns, changing each affected place before subtracting.
Add the subtrahend and difference to check that they recover the starting number.
